---
title: "augment_Martina"
format: html
---

1)  Load data

```{r}
metadata <- read_csv("data/processed/metadata.csv")
```

2.  Normalise and transform the counts

As the counts table currently contains raw counts, we decided to proceed using counts per million (CPM), followed by a log2 transformation.

```{r}
counts_log <- counts |>
  mutate(across(
      -gene_id,
      ~ log2((.x / sum(.x)) * 1000000 + 1) #log2tranformation of CPM
    )
  )
```

Each sample is a separate column. For further analysis we make sample become a row for each gene.

```{r}
counts_long <- counts_log |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -gene_id,
    names_to = "sample_id",
    values_to = "expression"
  )
```

And unite it with the metadata

```{r}
expression_data <- counts_long |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "sample_id")
```

Save the augmented data

```{r}
write_csv(expression_data, "data/processed/expression_data.csv")
```
